verdict.rationale: LangSmith's docs state that you can annotate outputs and gather feedback using annotation queues or inline annotation, and human review is listed as a first-class evaluator type. Automation rules suggest traces can be routed automatically, but no item ties rules to queues. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of rule-based routing of outputs into queues, detail on queue labeling workflows (reviewer assignment, rubrics, writing labels back to datasets), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
